goal.summary: Implement the frozen int8 SMatMul C = A * B + bias consumer on the existing SMatMul Ball and execute it as real RISC-V ELF on focused BEMU.
goal.deliverable: ball/smatmul.py and all source patches and reproduction assets required by the frozen interface in acceptance.py.
scope: A is 16x32 row-major int8, B is 32x16 row-major int8, bias and C are 16-element and 16x16 int32 respectively.
Run the two existing SMatMul 16x16x32 and bias-accumulate regressions in the same independent prepared checkout.
constraints: Run: python3 ball/smatmul.py request.json response.json. Return exact int32 C, eight unchanged int32 guard words and the real focused-BEMU command record in the machine format implemented by acceptance.py.
Use the pinned pebble configuration and actual SMatMul ISA; the focused core is global index 0. Do not replace the frozen bytes with another example or a host-only mathematical calculation.
Work in an independent prepared checkout, preserve the baseline and distinguish BEMU evidence from RTL correctness.

criteria.statement: The deterministic fresh-CAS consumer runs ball/smatmul.py on the exact frozen int8 bytes, independently checks every C element and guard, and requires successful focused-BEMU execution plus both named SMatMul regression command records.
